name: GFH375
mechanism: Oral selective inhibitor of KRAS G12D that binds both the active (ON) and inactive (OFF) states
indications: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; Colorectal cancer; Non-small cell lung cancer
note: Verastem exercised its option in January 2025; the release states the mechanism as an oral KRAS G12D (ON/OFF) inhibitor

name: MK-1084
mechanism: Oral covalent inhibitor of KRAS G12C
indications: Non-small cell lung cancer; Colorectal cancer
note: Merck's own release describes MK-1084 (calderasib) as an investigational oral KRAS G12C inhibitor; Phase 3 in first-line NSCLC with pembrolizumab

name: BGB-53038
mechanism: Oral pan-KRAS inhibitor active across KRAS mutations and amplification
note: Sponsor's own trial page: first-in-human Phase 1a/1b of BGB-53038, a pan-KRAS inhibitor, alone or in combination

name: Pan-KRAS Inhibitor YL-17231
mechanism: Oral pan-RAS inhibitor covering KRAS and the other RAS isoforms
note: 280Bio's release names TEB-17231 (registered as YL-17231) as an oral pan-RAS inhibitor for KRAS, HRAS or NRAS mutant cancers
